query: SELECT mol_id, greedy_clusters_0p5, greedy_clusters_1p0, post_pb_confs FROM per_ligand_long WHERE ligand_set = ? AND method = ?
aggregation: Arithmetic mean over entries with defined clustering values; both radii have identical measurable-entry sets per method. Retained counts use all 94 entries.
sort: Descending unrounded mean cluster count at 0.5 Angstrom; ties retain source order.
note: Read-only aggregation of archived cluster counts; no new conformer generation or clustering.
